# The Locked Door

Mira lived in a small house near the sea. Every morning she walked to
school with her brother. One day she found an old key on the beach. The
key was small and gold. She put it in her pocket and ran home.

At home Mira looked at every door. None of the doors opened with the
key. Her brother laughed at her. He said the key was not important. But
Mira did not agree. She wanted to find the right door.

# The Old House

The next day Mira walked past an old house at the end of the street. The
house had a small blue door. Mira took the key from her pocket. She put
the key in the lock and turned it. The door opened slowly.

Inside the house Mira found an old box. The box had letters from a girl
who lived there long ago. Mira read the letters with her brother. They
learned about the girl and her family. Mira smiled. She had found
something special, and now she knew why the key mattered.
